_comment: Channels lex_bot watches for raised issues + questions. It must be a MEMBER of each — chat:write.public lets it POST to a channel it hasn't joined, but reading history needs membership (a non-member read returns not_in_channel). To add a channel: /invite @lex_bot (user id U0ATYFBQULW) in Slack, then add {id,name} below (or run: users.conversations to list current membership). The notify channel (lex-notifications) is deliberately absent — it is Lex's private output, never watched. Private channels can only be joined by invite. DMs are always watched — no config. Per-conversation last-seen ts lives in state/slack-seen/, not here, so this file stays hand-editable.
